title: Community Service Export Freshness
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:impact source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures service export lag by data source for community-service feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside community-service feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `service export lag` on `community:impact` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst service export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long things take for each data source so you can see where community-service feeds slows down.
